gates.name: Package and runtime validation
gates.proof: Canonical review pack v3.0.0 validated with 29 skills, zero errors, zero warnings; isolated READ_ONLY runtime initialized with run_id and tool inventory.

gates.name: Discovery and immutable baseline
gates.proof: Discovery and Git scanners exited 0; npm markers, runtime versions, HEAD, branch, remotes, worktree, dirty state, and rollback anchor are recorded.

gates.name: Building blocks, DAG, and applicable specialist selection
gates.proof: BB-DAG is constructed from the canonical registry; 11 applicable specialist skills were installed into an isolated custom root with no missing or invalid skills and no collisions.

gates.name: OAuth, identity, authorization, and MCP session isolation
gates.proof: Block 1 identity E2E, OAuth device HTTP/CLI E2E, the 23-ID negative matrix, and current positive authenticated MCP E2E all exit 0; resource, scope, principal, and session binding controls are evidenced.

gates.name: Application security and DevSecOps
gates.proof: Static security review, URL hardening regression, secret-safe logging, and P0 negative matrix pass locally; the isolated real-server CSRF/XSS/SQLi probe could not bind its test port and is explicitly not treated as PASS.
blockers: Authorized real-server DAST probe incomplete; hosted secret scan and signed SBOM/provenance are unknown.

gates.name: Testing, quality, and performance
gates.proof: 41 source test files, 15 script E2E/integration files, current coverage gate exit 0, positive E2E, resilience, idempotency, bundle audit, and query/fault tests pass; historical Wave 1/Wave 2 aggregate RED artifacts remain preserved.
blockers: Browser-host E2E/visual traces and complete macOS/Windows chaos/Swarm equivalence are not proven; retained aggregate RED artifacts require reconciliation rather than deletion.

gates.name: API and data contract integrity
gates.proof: HTTP/MCP/OAuth surface inventory, read-only contract scan, schema/migration inventory, query-plan tests, SQLite fault tests, and idempotency recovery pass locally.
blockers: No independently published versioned API compatibility contract; runtime production schema comparison and backup/restore drill are unknown.

gates.name: Observability and SRE
gates.proof: Local observability contract passes with 15 metrics, 13 alerts, 12 dashboard panels, no secret leak, readiness endpoint, safe dimensions, and monitor evidence.
blockers: Hosted scrape, alert firing, notification delivery, recovery, SLO/error-budget operation, and incident drill are UNKNOWN.

gates.name: CI/CD reproducibility and supply-chain provenance
gates.proof: GitHub Actions smoke matrix and staging-load job define install, typecheck, test, build, E2E, security, coverage, bundle, observability, artifacts, and doctor gates across Ubuntu/macOS/Windows smoke.
blockers: No SBOM, signed attestation, build-once/promote digest, or deployment artifact provenance is proven.

gates.name: Deployment, rollback, backup, and disaster recovery
gates.proof: A local rollback anchor exists, but no deployment target, promotion environment, executed rollback, SQLite restore, or disaster-recovery drill is available in evidence.
blockers: Release candidate cannot be traced to a deployed artifact; promotion and reversal are unproven; backup/restore is unproven.

gates.name: GitHub Intelligence and learning loop
gates.proof: Adopt/Adapt/Avoid stances were captured and applied to baseline immutability, skill versioning, specification-before-mutation, observability adaptation, provenance gap tracking, dynamic selection, and scanner claims.
blockers: Remote GitHub provenance and signed attestation availability remain UNKNOWN.

gates.name: Independent verification and synthesis
gates.proof: Specialist ledger, findings, roadmap, and this gate matrix preserve evidence, unknowns, rollback posture, and a non-release-ready decision without averaging away the RED release gate.
blockers: Independent hosted release verification cannot complete until G9 prerequisites exist.

critical_blockers.title: Production identity gateway/RBAC/key rotation not proven
Hosted Prometheus/Grafana alert firing and recovery not proven
Write-to-ACK ambiguous interval remains for non-reversible process/stdin effects
Hosted load calibration and provider/runtime behavior unknown
Explicit RBAC, key rotation, and provenance automation backlog

release_rule: Do not mark RELEASE_READY while any P0/P1 is unresolved or G9 is RED.
